pokedexEntries.lgpe: It melts particles of iron and other metals found in the subsoil, so it can absorb them into its body of molten steel.

pokedexEntries.sw: It dissolves and eats metal. Circulating liquid metal within its body is how it generates energy.

pokedexEntries.sh: They live as a group, but when the time comes, one strong Meltan will absorb all the others and evolve.

pokedexEntries.za: Its body is made up of molten steel. It melts particles of iron and other metals it finds in the ground and absorbs them into itself.
